title: Mixed Event — Scramble Fan Festival! — Episode8 Last Minute Shout Out

meta.Event Outline: Minori, Ichika, Kohane and Nene are all set to sing in the annual VIRTUAL SINGER Fan Festival. Kanade and the rest of N25 also attend, keen to witness their favorite creators. The curtains rise, uniting heartfelt emotions into a grand symphony!

rows.Line: Green Room

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's almost time for the singers to go up...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm getting nervous...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
There were so many people too.
You feel it each time they roared...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Right.
But I think Minori's the most nervous out of all of us...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
It is her first solo performance.
She said was just going outside for a bit, but I hope she's okay...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, someone's coming.
Could it be Minori?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh...?
Backstage

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Breathe in, breathe out...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, it's not working...
My heart just won't settle down...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (We just did that show at the elementary school the other day too... But I'm all alone this time... I'm so nervous...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (What if I make a mistake? What if I let everyone down...?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh no, my legs are starting to shake... How are the others able to perform on stage the way they do...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Can I really do this...?
Ah, there you are!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh? Tsukasa...?
What are you doing here...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: To cheer Nene on, of course, but I heard that a certain someone was starting to get a little too nervous.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As someone who has quite a bit of experience performing on stage, I came to check up on you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-Thank you so much...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So what's bothering you? Why are you so nervous?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Well, actually...
This is my first time performing all by myself in front of a crowd.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I thought that I'd made some progress after doing all those streams and performing for some kids, but I was completely wrong.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: There's just no way I can go up there all alone and spread hope to everyone...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm no expert when it comes to idols, Hanasato, but...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The stage is a magnificent place where the masses can gather and see you standing in the spotlight!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's a place where you can show the audience just how hard you worked on your singing and dancing!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You mentioned how you wish to “spread hope to everyone”, yes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I admit it's natural to feel a little nervous about going up there.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, if you succeed, you'll be able to inspire hope in all these people!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(He's right...!
I was so worried about everything not going right that I forgot about this being a chance to spread hope!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I can do it... Just like Haruka that one time...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's not every day that you get a chance to spread hope to so many people like this!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You can do it, Hanasato!
Just believe in all the hard work you've done!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I will!!
Thank you very much, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Good response...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And if you start feeling nervous again, just increase your volume! Take a deep breath and...

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Excuse me, please keep it down back there!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, pardon me...!
Anyway, Hanasato, keep warming up! Quietly...!

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Please keep it down!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... This is quite the predicament...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha.

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Green Room

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I hope Hanasato's okay...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Neneee!
Wonderhoy dive!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
...?!
E-Emu, please don't try to tackle me like that. You really startled me...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Also, did you just jump down from the ceiling? How did you even get up there?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe♪ I went all slithy-slither through the ceiling and went for a dive after I saw you, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That doesn't really answer either of my questions...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But it is nice to see a familiar face. Thanks for stopping by...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's almost time...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I never imagined being here performing at the Fan Festival like this.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (This feels so strange. Until last year, I was watching from the other side.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I want to show Miku and the others just how much I appreciate them. I think with this song, I'll be able to the most...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Shiho! You're here...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah... You seem ready...
You have that same look as when we did that show the other day.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I do...?
But I'm so glad that you stopped by, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Now I'm certain that I'll be able to sing this song.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, I'll be watching with everyone else too, so break a leg...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're doing your own performance too, right, Kohane? It's normal to feel nervous, but you can do it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
R-Right...!
Thanks, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A-An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: How are you? Nervous?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yeah. This feels so different from performing at a live house.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I feel much better after seeing you here, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, really?
Haha. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Akito and Toya are here too, so we'll be watching together. Just sing like you usually do and you'll be just fine!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I know you can do it, Kohane!
Just believe in yourself and sing!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right, thanks...!
Oh... An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, Haruka!
What brings you...? Oh, right, you're here for Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right but...
How did you know?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We met the other day and ended up teaching her a little about singing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You did? I see...
Thank you for doing that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. You're very welcome♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, by the way, do you happen to know where she is right now? I've been looking all over for her...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, she just...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm back, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, welcome back!
A-Are you all better now...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! Tsukasa helped cheer me up just now. Hehe. Sorry about making you all worry so much!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Haruka...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank goodness you're here. There's something I've been meaning to tell you before everything got started.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Tell me...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. You may be going on stage alone today, but you aren't actually alone. We'll be there to cheer you on.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So whatever happens, you'll be fine. Just keep smiling like you always do, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you so much! I promise to do my best!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm gonna go up there and spread as much hope as I can!
